newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chesapeake Energy raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chesapeake Energy raised.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Christopher Eades said on Monday he had raised his rating for Chesapeake Energy Corp to buy from hold.

-- "We calculate Chesapeake's adjusted net asset value at $34.44/share (adjusted for drilling upside). We believe CHK shares should trade at par with our adjusted net asset value," Eades wrote in a report.
-- "CHK shares are currently trading at 6.5x our 1998 cash flow estimate of $4.05/share. We believe CHK shares should trade up to 9.0x cash flow or $36.50/share.
-- "Combining these tow valuation criteria, we have established a price target of $34.50-$36.50. This represents upside potential of 31-39 percent."
-- The company's shares closed at 26-1/4 on Friday.
